name: visibledotdot-budget
description: visible.. budget — test harness for projection maths (no runtime deps)

scripts.test:tz: for z in UTC Europe/London Australia/Sydney America/Los_Angeles America/Santiago Pacific/Kiritimati; do out=$(TZ=$z node --test test/*.test.js 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; echo "FAILED under TZ=$z"; exit 1; }; echo "TZ=$z $(echo "$out" | grep -E '^# (pass|fail|todo)' | tr '\n' ' ')"; done
